Oneliner

Educational space systems engineering and Earth imaging.
Description

Its primary mission was Earth imaging, with several secondary missions including orbit determination, amateur-radio communications, passive stabilization techniques, attitude detection, and composite-material research.

Failure cause Problem in power system prevented the solar arrays from supplying power.
